summary: Iteration 6 – Freshness-Guard + Gap-Backfill scheduler refactor: fully verified. Unit-tests (test_scanner_freshness.py 7 tests + test_worker_package.py::TestWorkerPackageFiles 3 tests) all green. Preview URL regression (test_iter6_scanner_regression.py, 5 tests) all green: /api/signals 200, /api/session/status is_active=true, /api/autotrade/trades 200, /api/autotrade/config 200, /api/klines/BTCUSDT last-candle age <10min. Backend logs: 0 'Scan error' entries, 0 'autotrade monitor error', 0 'Marktdaten veraltet' warnings (no stale symbols right now), 0 'Kerzen-Lücke' fills (no gaps happened – expected/organic). Dashboard smoke: LIVE label shows '1MIN · LIVE · 200 bars', 8 canvases, 117 SVG paths (EMA 9/50/200 visible in chart legend), 24 rule-state elements filled (Trend EMA 50 met/RSI Momentum unmet green/grey circles), BTCUSDT price 64019.20 live, session '24/7 MODE · ACTIVE', 0 JS/page errors. Code review of core/scheduler.py: STALE_AFTER_MS=4min, _is_stale correctly whitelists yahoo instruments, _needs_backfill uses >60s gap between buf[-1].ts and klines[0].ts, fresh-only gating for prices[symbol] and evaluate_open_signals is correct, broadcast candle+rule_states runs unconditionally (matches spec).
critical_code_review_comments: core/scheduler.py::_is_stale – correct: uses core.instruments.get(symbol).live_source == 'yahoo' to exempt Gold/Öl/Forex (trading pauses). Fallback (unknown symbol) treats as crypto -> stale check applies. STALE_AFTER_MS=4min is generous enough for 12s poll interval but tight enough to catch a truly frozen feed.

core/scheduler.py::_needs_backfill – threshold `>60000ms` between buf[-1].timestamp and klines[0].timestamp correctly requires a strict gap (consecutive minutes NOT triggering). Backfill fetches 200 candles and only replaces `klines` when `len(filler) >= len(klines)` – safe fallback if the deep fetch fails/returns short.

core/scheduler.py::start_scanner – fresh-gated writes to prices[symbol] AND fresh-gated evaluate_open_signals(symbol, price) correctly prevent stale SL/TP hits. broadcast of candle + rule_states ALWAYS runs (as designed for the UI 'LIVE · 200 bars' chart which should keep rendering the last candle even when the feed pauses).

core/scheduler.py – Log-Drossel _stale_warned[symbol]: nur 1 Warn-Zeile pro 10 min pro Symbol – guter Kompromiss (kein Log-Flood, aber sichtbar). Persists forever in-process; acceptable (small dict, ~20 symbols).
tests/conftest.py – lädt backend/.env + frontend/.env korrekt via os.environ.setdefault (überschreibt NICHT bereits gesetzte Werte -> CI-freundlich).

Minor nit (non-blocking): _stale_warned key aging – dict never prunes. In a very long-running process a symbol removed from ALL_SYMBOLS would leave a stale entry. Practically irrelevant with the current symbol universe.
Minor nit (non-blocking): STALE_AFTER_MS is a module constant, not env-configurable. If a slow exotic feed shows up (e.g. new emerging-market coin) tuning requires code edit + redeploy. Not urgent.
